# pai doc

Write the Markdown command reference

```
pai doc [options]
```

Regenerates the reference from the same definitions `pai help` reads, so the docs cannot drift from the commands. Prints to stdout unless --out is given.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out FILE` | string | — | Write to this file instead of stdout |
| `--dir DIR` | string | — | Write one page per command plus README.md into this folder (used by the docs build) |
| `--examples DIR` | string | — | With --dir: splice hand-written <command>.md examples from this folder |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | Show where it would write, write nothing |

```sh
pai doc
pai doc --out docs/cli.md
pai doc --dir docs/commands --examples docs/commands/_examples
```

See also: `pai help`
